Rows.English: This item cannot be purchased right now.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 背包或道具槽位已满，无法购买。
Rows.English: Backpack or prop slots are full.

Rows.ChineseSimplified:
训练场数据
未找到训练目标
Rows.English:
Training Data
Training target was not found.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 当前技能和咏唱时间增加50%、伤害降低30%、蓝耗翻倍；下一个技能不耗蓝
Rows.English: Current skill cast time +50%, damage -30%, and mana cost doubled; the next skill costs no mana.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 0.1秒后追加一次同技能执行，第二次伤害降低20%
Rows.English: Execute the same skill again after 0.1 seconds; the second hit deals 20% less damage.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 扣除10%最大生命但不会致死，当前技能伤害提高50%，范围提高25%
Rows.English: Lose 10% max health without dying; current skill damage +50% and area +25%.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 后续三次携带该加成的技能分别减少300/200/100 MP，并降低30%/20%/10%伤害
Rows.English: The next three skills with this addition cost 300/200/100 less mana and deal 30%/20%/10% less damage.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 技能期间第一次受到的伤害为0
Rows.English: The first hit taken during the skill deals no damage.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 当前技能行动速度提高50%
当前技能范围提高20%，下一个技能伤害降低50%
Rows.English: Current skill area +20%; next skill damage -50%.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 当前技能伤害提高25%，下一个技能伤害降低50%
Rows.English: Current skill damage +25%; next skill damage -50%.
Increase maximum mana and mana regeneration by 1000.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 选择一个存档，继续冒险
Rows.English: Choose a save to continue your adventure

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 选择一个位置，开始新的冒险
Rows.English: Choose a slot to begin a new adventure

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 选择后立即切换并保存
双击购买 · 拖入背包购买
Rows.English: Double-click or drag to your bag to buy
Drag to the left to sell

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 双击取出 · 拖入背包
Rows.English: Double-click or drag to your bag to withdraw

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 双击存入 · 拖到左侧
Rows.English: Double-click or drag to the left to store
The handbook is not available yet

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 每条技能链最多可配置 {0} 个技能
Rows.English: Each skill chain can hold up to {0} skills

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 是否返回主菜单？未保存的进度将丢失。
Rows.English: Return to the main menu? Unsaved progress will be lost.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 就是这里了……我的第一份独立委托。
Rows.English: Here it is... my first independent commission.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 只调查魔晶异常的外围，应该不会太难。
Rows.English: I'm surveying the outskirts for crystal anomalies. It should be manageable.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 不过，真遇到魔物，可没人替我收拾残局。还是先把准备做好。
Rows.English: But nobody will bail me out if I meet monsters. I'd better prepare.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 先找一块合适的魔法石。我熟悉火系法术，火焰石应该不错。
Rows.English: First, a magic stone. I'm familiar with fire spells, so a Fire Stone should suit me.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 双击火焰石，购买 1 件（30 金币）。
Rows.English: Double-click Fire Stone and buy one (30 gold).

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 前往金色标记处，按 E 与商人交谈。
Rows.English: Go to the gold marker and press E to talk to the merchant.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 本店物品已买齐。点击返回，继续准备出征。
Rows.English: Items acquired. Click Back to continue preparing.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 再带点药剂。受伤可以处理，魔力耗尽就只能逃了。
Rows.English: I should bring potions. Wounds can be treated, but without mana I'll have to run.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 双击小型体力药剂，购买 1 件（30 金币）。
Rows.English: Double-click Small Health Potion and buy one (30 gold).

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 前往金色标记处，按 E 与商人交谈。
Rows.English: Go to the gold marker and press E to talk to the merchant.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 双击小型魔力药剂，购买 1 件（30 金币）。
Rows.English: Double-click Small Mana Potion and buy one (30 gold).

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 前往金色标记处，按 E 与商人交谈。
Rows.English: Go to the gold marker and press E to talk to the merchant.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 本店物品已买齐。点击返回，继续准备出征。
Rows.English: Items acquired. Click Back to continue preparing.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 我想添几招火系法术。只靠火球，总觉得不太够。
Rows.English: I'd like more fire spells. Fireball alone doesn't feel like enough.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 双击火球技能石，购买 1 件（30 金币）。
Rows.English: Double-click Fireball skill stone and buy one (30 gold).

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 前往金色标记处，按 E 与商人交谈。
Rows.English: Go to the gold marker and press E to talk to the merchant.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 双击火径技能石，购买 1 件（30 金币）。
Rows.English: Double-click Fire Path skill stone and buy one (30 gold).

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 前往金色标记处，按 E 与商人交谈。
Rows.English: Go to the gold marker and press E to talk to the merchant.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 双击焦土技能石，购买 1 件（30 金币）。
Rows.English: Double-click Scorched Earth skill stone and buy one (30 gold).

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 前往金色标记处，按 E 与商人交谈。
Rows.English: Go to the gold marker and press E to talk to the merchant.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 本店物品已买齐。点击返回，继续准备出征。
Rows.English: Items acquired. Click Back to continue preparing.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 买齐了。先整理一下，放在背包里可发挥不了作用。
Rows.English: Everything's bought. Time to organize it; it won't help in my backpack.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 把火焰石拖到魔法石槽。
Rows.English: Drag the Fire Stone into the magic stone slot.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 按 B 打开角色界面，装备魔法石和药剂。
Rows.English: Press B to open your character and equip your stone and potions.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 把体力药剂拖到道具槽 1。
Rows.English: Drag the Health Potion into item slot 1.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 按 B 打开角色界面，装备魔法石和药剂。
Rows.English: Press B to open your character and equip your stone and potions.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 把魔力药剂拖到道具槽 2。
Rows.English: Drag the Mana Potion into item slot 2.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 按 B 打开角色界面，装备魔法石和药剂。
Rows.English: Press B to open your character and equip your stone and potions.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 先用火球起手，再接火径，最后铺下焦土。把火球拖入第一条技能链。
Rows.English: Fireball first, then Fire Path, and finally Scorched Earth. Drag Fireball into chain 1.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 按 B 打开角色界面，切换到技能页。
Rows.English: Press B to open your character and select Skills.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 把火径拖到第一条技能链末尾：火球 → 火径 → 焦土。
Rows.English: Drag Fire Path to the end of chain 1: Fireball → Fire Path → Scorched Earth.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 按 B 打开角色界面，切换到技能页。
Rows.English: Press B to open your character and select Skills.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 把焦土拖到第一条技能链末尾：火球 → 火径 → 焦土。
Rows.English: Drag Scorched Earth to the end of chain 1: Fireball → Fire Path → Scorched Earth.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 按 B 打开角色界面，切换到技能页。
Rows.English: Press B to open your character and select Skills.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 配装完成。按 Esc 关闭角色界面。
Rows.English: Loadout complete. Press Esc to close the character panel.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 魔法石、药剂、技能……都齐了。去确认一下地牢入口吧。
Rows.English: Magic stone, potions, spells... ready. Time to check the dungeon entrance.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 点击「进入地牢」。目标是调查外围，记得活着回来。
Rows.English: Click Enter Dungeon. Survey the outskirts and come back alive.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 前往金色标记处，按 E 与训练师交谈，确认地牢入口。
Rows.English: Go to the gold marker and press E to ask the trainer about the dungeon entrance.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 我接了地牢外围的调查委托，想找块合适的魔法石。
Rows.English: I've accepted an outskirts survey. I'd like a suitable magic stone.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 第一次出征？你擅长什么法术？
Rows.English: Your first expedition? What magic do you use?
Fire magic. Fireball is my most familiar spell.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 擅长火系？那就选火焰石，能增强你的火系法术。
Rows.English: Choose a Fire Stone to strengthen your fire spells.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 买好后记得装进魔法石槽。放在包里，它可帮不上忙。
Rows.English: Equip it in the magic stone slot after buying. It won't help in your backpack.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 要去地牢？药剂准备了吗？
Rows.English: Heading to the dungeon? Prepared your potions?

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 只是去外围调查，也需要带吗？
魔物可不会看你的委托写了什么。
体力药剂处理伤势，魔力药剂补充施法消耗。两种都带上一瓶，别等撑不住了才想起来。
Rows.English: Health potions treat wounds; mana potions replenish casting energy. Bring one of each before you need them.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 我想添几招火系法术。只靠火球，总觉得不太够。
Rows.English: I'd like more fire spells. Fireball alone doesn't feel like enough.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 会几招是一回事，能把它们接起来，又是另一回事。
Rows.English: Knowing spells is one thing; chaining them is another.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 火球起手，火径攻击直线上的敌人，焦土覆盖一片区域。这三招，够你先熟悉技能链了。
Rows.English: Start with Fireball, attack along a line with Fire Path, then cover an area with Scorched Earth. These will teach you chains.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 先这样试。等你摸清每一招的节奏，再换成自己的组合。
Rows.English: Try that first. Once you learn the rhythm, make your own combination.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 还有，技能石买回去要编进链里。背包不是施法的地方。
Rows.English: Put skill stones into your chain after buying. You can't cast from your backpack.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 装备和药剂都准备好了，技能链也编好了。我来确认地牢入口。
Rows.English: My loadout and skill chain are ready. I'm here to check the dungeon entrance.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 对，确认魔晶异常的情况，回来报告。
Rows.English: Yes. Investigate the crystal anomalies and bring back a report.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 那就记住你的目标。看清情况、找到撤离的机会，不必和每只魔物纠缠。
Rows.English: Remember your objective: observe, look for a way out, and don't fight every monster.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 带出去的东西，倒下就可能丢掉。能活着把消息带回来，这份委托才算完成。
Rows.English: Defeat may cost you what you carry. Bring the news back alive to finish the commission.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 确认数量为 1，点击购买（正常扣除金币）。
Rows.English: Quantity is one. Confirm the purchase; gold is charged.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 这不是当前需要的物品。先点击取消。
Rows.English: This isn't the requested item. Click Cancel.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 点击「技能」页签，编排技能链。
Rows.English: Click Skills to arrange your chain.

Rows.ChineseSimplified: 点击「装备」页签，放入装备和药剂。
Rows.English: Click Equipment to equip your stone and potions.
